units_chirho.rationale_chirho: Opening frame of the chapter's lesson: keep the commandments so they keep you from the strange woman (7:5).
units_chirho.title_chirho: Keep my words; call wisdom your sister
art_choices_chirho: the frame may be shown as the father teaching his son, consistent with the watcher of 7:6-7

units_chirho.rationale_chirho: The narrator looks out through the lattice and sees a simple young man walk toward her house at dusk into night.
units_chirho.title_chirho: At my window I watched the young man

roles_chirho.text_facts_chirho: looks through the window lattice of his own house (7:6) and sees (7:7)
among the simple and the youths, lacking sense (7:7); passes near her corner (7:8)

art_choices_chirho: the narrator's age and appearance (consistent with the teaching father of 7:1-5)
units_chirho.uncertainty_chirho: Hebrew (MT, which Hinneh follows) has the narrator at the window in 7:6; the Greek LXX puts the woman there. So 7:6 and 7:7 both show the same narrator watching.

units_chirho.rationale_chirho: A woman dressed as a harlot meets him, loud and restless, lying in wait at corners; she seizes and kisses him.

roles_chirho.text_facts_chirho: harlot's attire, crafty heart (7:10); loud, stubborn, not staying home (7:11-12)
still the observer, at his window

art_choices_chirho: the specific dress, kept modest per project norms

units_chirho.rationale_chirho: Her persuasion: vows paid and peace offerings, a prepared bed with Egyptian linen and spices, the husband away.

roles_chirho.text_facts_chirho: absent on a long journey with a bag of money, returning at the full moon (7:19-20); not present

art_choices_chirho: show speaker and listener in the street at night; the bed and spices are things she describes, not the setting
units_chirho.uncertainty_chirho: 7:20 'the day appointed' may mean the full moon. The husband is described, not seen.

units_chirho.rationale_chirho: Won by her smooth talk he goes after her at once, like an ox to slaughter, a bird to the snare.
units_chirho.uncertainty_chirho: Ox, fetters, arrow and snare are comparisons, not scene elements.

units_chirho.rationale_chirho: Closing frame: listen, children; many strong men have fallen by her.
units_chirho.title_chirho: Her house is the way to Sheol
